audit_revision.reason: v1 incorrectly sorted gateway JSON keys; v2 preserves insertion order exactly as model_gateway.wire

field_map.benchmark_summary_latency: summary.wall_ms uses measured rows without error; it is NOT a correct-only latency
field_map.completed_latency: rows[warmup=false, no error, result.status=completed].wall_ms; incorrect completed rows are counted separately
field_map.correctness: rows.correct plus completed status, exact stdout, one tool, final feedback audit and model_capture_complete
field_map.cpu: metrics.cpu.cgroup_nonoverlap_observed_seconds and process_lifecycle_observed_seconds separately; never add or divide by measured case count
field_map.model_identity: advertised request model only; provider weights/deployment pin remains unknown
field_map.model_usage: adjacent model/*.response.sse response.completed.usage; result.usage is not a fallback
field_map.primary_memory: metrics.memory.pss_peak_complete_sample_bytes with complete/incomplete samples, sampling gaps and coverage
field_map.request_budget: actual *.request.json bytes/model/max_output_tokens plus gateway record effective hash/cap
field_map.resource_window: metrics.elapsed_seconds; whole lane includes startup, warmup, observer and shutdown
field_map.secondary_memory: RSS and partial PSS are diagnostics only; no cgroup lifetime peak is used
field_map.startup_shutdown: startup_ms / shutdown_ms, separate from case latency; shutdown is not proof of graceful exit

limitations: Whole-lane CPU/memory includes startup, warmup, observer and shutdown; it is not steady-state per-case cost.
PSS completeness describes observed selected scopes, not global coverage; sampled peaks are lower bounds.
Cgroup memory.peak is cumulative lifetime high-water and is deliberately excluded.
Process CPU, cgroup CPU, waited-child CPU and observer CPU overlap; they must not be added.
Observer CPU is active sampling-call thread_time, not total observer-process CPU; active sampling wall excludes interval waits.
Sampler CPU subtraction cannot reconstruct uninstrumented executor cost, latency, memory, GIL, scheduling, I/O or cache effects.
Live upstream model compute/memory and some loopback SSH/control-plane work are outside measured scopes.
Replay usage is synthetic and must not be presented as actual token consumption.
Small sequential samples, caches and changing host/provider load do not establish stable superiority.
No normal benchmark result proves original-operation recovery; that needs separate fault evidence.
Captured model-call counts cover admitted requests; attempts rejected before gateway recording are not an exhaustive HTTP attempt log.

all_catalogued_usage.scope: provider-reported usage in catalogued captures only; not unobserved provider work or billing

measured_usage.scope: provider-reported usage in catalogued captures only; not unobserved provider work or billing

warmup_usage.scope: provider-reported usage in catalogued captures only; not unobserved provider work or billing

external_work_declared: Loopback sshd/control-plane work outside explicit local PID/cgroup scopes can be omitted
Upstream model service process tree and compute are not measured
coverage.remote_model_or_ssh_work: Not included unless measured separately or represented by explicit local PID/cgroup scope. A local client/gateway alone does not measure remote inference.

sampling_interpretation.cpu_clock: sum of per-_sample calling-thread time.thread_time deltas; includes synchronous start/stop samples
sampling_interpretation.wall_clock: sum of active _sample time.monotonic deltas; excludes inter-sample event.wait intervals

measurement_windows.case_wall: Send run or thread/start through successful/failed case result; excludes resident startup and shutdown
measurement_windows.resources: Whole lane from before backend launch through client/gateway shutdown; includes warmup and observer
